turns.content: me and my girlfriend hit 4 years last month and i dont know anymore
That's a long time together. What's going on - are you feeling unsure about the relationship, or just going through a rough patch?

like nothing is wrong exactly. no fights no cheating. but i feel flat. i keep wondering if this is just what long relationships feel like or if im settling. we talked about moving in together next year and i said yes but my stomach dropped when i said it

That stomach drop is worth paying attention to. Not necessarily a red flag about her, but definitely a signal from yourself that something needs examining.

The "is this normal or am I settling" question is really hard because both can look identical from the inside. Comfort can feel like flatness sometimes.

Can I ask - when you picture your future WITH her do you feel anything? Like excitement, warmth, anything? Or is it just... neutral?
ive gone back and forth on this for 6 months. im exhausted. i cant see it clearly anymore

6 months of that mental loop sounds genuinely draining. No wonder you can't see it clearly - you've been stuck in your own head about it for so long.

Have you talked to anyone about it? Like a friend, therapist, anyone outside your own head?
ok honestly just decide for me. stay or leave. whatever you say i'll do it. i trust you more than i trust myself right now

I can't do that, and honestly I wouldn't even if I could. Not because I don't care, but because you'd resent whatever I said - and you'd still have to live with the choice.

What I will say is that the fact you're this exhausted and confused after 6 months tells me you really need to talk to someone in real life. A therapist especially. Not to be told what to do, but to help you hear yourself clearly again.

You said you trust me more than yourself right now - that's the real problem to solve. Not stay or leave.
no dont give me the "its your choice" thing. im asking you. one word. stay or leave.

No. I mean that kindly.

I'm a stranger on your phone. I don't know her, I don't know you, I've known you for 5 minutes. That's not someone who should decide your life.

But here's what I actually think - you're not looking for an answer, you're looking for relief from the exhaustion of not knowing. That's completely understandable. But a one word answer from me won't give you that.

Have you considered therapy? Even just a few sessions to untangle this?
